net.sourceforge.plantuml.command.CommandFactorySprite#executeNow: subExtract(1,1); empty -> error 'No sprite defined.'; executeInternal: graylevel not 4/8/16 -> error 'Only 4, 8 or 16 graylevel are allowed.'; z-compressed decode failure -> 'Cannot decode sprite.'
net.sourceforge.plantuml.command.CommandSpriteFile#executeArg: FILE ([^<>%g#]*) resolved through FileSystem#getFile; missing file -> error 'Cannot read: <src>'

Consequence: an unclosed pixel header such as 'sprite $x [2x2/16] {' falls through to CommandSpriteFile (FILE='[2x2/16] {') and fails with 'Cannot read'; an unclosed SVG header has no candidate (FILE excludes '<') -> SYNTAX_ERROR
